The Cheat Pill provides fat and calorie control while further reducing cravings. The herb Cassia nomame blocks the enzyme lipase from breaking down fats into absorbable subunits, whereas Chitosan is a fiber that helps move the undigested fats by binding to them and pushing them through the intestinal tract and preventing absorption.* Appetite Suppressing Formula – The Cheat Pill also reduces appetite and cravings for high fat and high carb foods. White Kidney Bean Extract has demonstrated it inhibits the enzyme alpha-amylase. This enzyme helps break down complex starchy carbohydrates into simple sugars that can be absorbed. Designed for hard-training lifters and athletes Targets multiple performance pathways in one stack Convenient, cost-effective alternative to buying products individually Easy to integrate into any strength or hypertrophy program Who It’s For Lifters focused on muscle and strength gains Athletes looking to support training performance and recovery Anyone wanting a simple, effective muscle-support stack { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-6f168497-a4cb-427f-8505-23c8a89bb94a" } } Backed by Science The LLL Mass Stack combines ingredients aimed at supporting muscle growth, strength, and hormonal balance as part of a comprehensive training program. While supplements cannot replace hard training and proper nutrition, several components in this stack are grounded in scientific research: • D-Aspartic Acid (D-AA):D-Aspartic Acid is an amino acid involved in hormone signaling pathways and has been studied for its potential to influence testosterone production. Some early research showed short-term increases in circulating testosterone in certain populations, particularly in men with lower baseline levels, but results are mixed in resistance-trained individuals—with several controlled trials showing no significant benefit on testosterone, strength, or muscle mass in trained lifters. • Herbal Hormone Support (Maca Root, Fenugreek, Saw Palmetto):Botanicals like maca root and fenugreek are traditionally used for overall energy and hormonal support. While maca may help with general well-being and stamina, evidence for a direct boost in testosterone is limited and inconclusive. Fenugreek appears safe and may aid metabolic and hormonal balance, but definitive clinical data for muscle-building claims are still emerging. Saw palmetto, commonly included for prostate health, has limited evidence supporting hormonal or performance benefits. Ecdysterone (20-Hydroxyecdysone) Ecdysterone is a naturally occurring phytoecdysteroid found in plants such as quinoa and spinach. It belongs to a class of compounds originally identified as insect molting hormones but now studied for potential anabolic effects in mammals. Mechanism: Ecdysterone appears to enhance muscle protein synthesis through intracellular signaling pathways like PI3K/Akt and may interact with estrogen receptor beta (ERβ), which can support muscle growth without binding to androgen receptors like testosterone does. Turkesterone Turkesterone is another phytoecdysteroid most often derived from the plant Ajuga turkestanica. Like ecdysterone, it is a plant-based steroid-like compound that does not bind to androgen receptors, making it non-hormonal. Mechanism: Turkesterone may support workouts by enhancing protein synthesis and metabolic pathways similar to ecdysterone, potentially influencing recovery and tissue repair. Massularia acuminata Extract — Backed by Science Massularia acuminata is a plant traditionally used in West Africa to support male vitality and performance. Modern research has begun to explore how this extract may support muscle-building and testosterone-related pathways. Preclinical studies show that Massularia acuminata extract may help support healthy testosterone levels, along with related hormones involved in strength, energy, and recovery. In animal research, supplementation was associated with increases in testosterone and improvements in protein activity within muscle-related tissues—key factors tied to muscle growth and physical performance. Unlike synthetic hormones, Massularia acuminata works by supporting the body’s natural hormonal signaling, making it a popular ingredient in performance-focused formulas designed to complement intense training and proper nutrition. While human clinical research is still emerging, its long history of traditional use combined with promising scientific findings makes Massularia acuminata a compelling ingredient for those looking to support strength, muscle development, and overall male performance. { "__shgImageV2Elements": { "uuid": "s-a0f1d100-f921-4f74-98fa-8ed3abbc2dba" } } ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) “Solid stack for strength-focused training”I’ve been lifting consistently for years and wanted something simple to support my training. L-Theanine: Promotes calm focus by balancing excitatory neurotransmitters and smoothing stimulant effects. 👉 Together, these ingredients help optimize brain signaling, allowing for sharper thinking and improved recall. 2. Adaptogens for Stress & Mental Performance Rhodiola Rosea: Helps combat mental fatigue and supports resilience under stress. Neuroprotection & Brain Health Cat’s Claw: Known for antioxidant properties that may help protect brain cells from oxidative stress. Bacopa + Lion’s Mane synergy: Supports long-term brain health, neurogenesis, and cognitive longevity. 👉 Limitless isn’t just about short-term performance—it’s designed to support your brain over time. 5. Synergistic Formula Design Rather than relying on a single stimulant or ingredient, Limitless uses a stacked nootropic approach, where each compound enhances the effectiveness of the others. This synergy helps deliver: Better focus Improved mood Enhanced memory Sustained mental energy This multi-ingredient strategy is why nootropic stacks are often more effective than standalone compounds for cognitive performance. title: Creatine Gummies by Legal Limit Labs

description.html: Strength Made Simple. Skip the shaker bottle. Forget messy powders. Legal Limit Labs® Creatine Gummies deliver 1 gram of creatine monohydrate per gummy in a delicious, convenient format that makes it easier than ever to stay consistent with your daily creatine routine. Whether you're headed to the gym, office, school, or traveling, simply grab your gummies and go. Why Creatine? Creatine monohydrate is one of the most extensively researched ingredients in sports nutrition. It plays a critical role in regenerating ATP (adenosine triphosphate), the body's primary source of energy during high-intensity exercise. Maintaining healthy muscle creatine stores may help support: Increased strength Improved power output Better training performance Lean muscle development Faster recovery between sets Enhanced high-intensity exercise capacity When paired with consistent resistance training, creatine remains one of the most trusted supplements available for athletes and active individuals { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-ef09d2c1-3fe3-491e-8096-710e365353b2" } } The Benefits of Creatine Creatine monohydrate is one of the most researched and trusted ingredients in sports nutrition. It plays a key role in the body’s ability to produce energy during high-intensity exercise and strength training. The Science Behind Creatine Creatine is a naturally occurring compound found in muscle cells. It helps regenerate adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the primary energy source used during high-intensity and explosive movements like weightlifting, sprinting, and interval training. During intense exercise, ATP is rapidly depleted. Supplementing with creatine helps replenish ATP levels more efficiently, allowing muscles to perform at higher intensities for longer periods. This is why creatine is widely used by athletes, lifters, and active individuals aiming to improve performance and training output. Creatine monohydrate is one of the most extensively studied sports nutrition ingredients, with decades of research supporting its effectiveness and safety when used as directed.* Why Creatine Gummies? Creatine Gummies provide the same active ingredient as traditional powders in a convenient, great-tasting format. With 1 gram of creatine monohydrate per gummy, they make it easy to stay consistent without mixing, measuring, or carrying a shaker. Consistency is key with creatine, and gummies offer a simple way to support daily intake—anytime, anywhere. { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-0535d7b5-e767-4e4e-9d8a-95dd42f40b4e" } } How to Use Take 3-5 gummies daily, or as directed by your healthcare professional. Can be taken any time of day, including pre- or post-workout. Frequently Asked Questions Are creatine gummies as effective as creatine powder?Yes. When they provide an effective daily amount of creatine monohydrate, gummies offer the same active ingredient as powders in a more convenient format. When should I take creatine gummies?Any time of day. Many people prefer taking them before or after training, but consistency matters most. Do I need to cycle creatine?No. Creatine monohydrate is intended for daily use, and cycling is not necessary when taken as directed. Can beginners take creatine?Absolutely. Creatine is one of the most studied sports nutrition ingredients and is suitable for beginners, experienced lifters, and recreational exercisers alike. Can women take creatine gummies?Yes. Creatine supports energy production in muscle and can be beneficial for both men and women with active lifestyles. Will creatine make me gain fat?No. Creatine does not cause body fat gain. Some people experience a small increase in water retained within muscle tissue, which is a normal part of how creatine works. Can I take creatine on rest days?Yes. Daily use helps maintain muscle creatine stores, even on days you don't train. What can I stack with Creatine Gummies?For even greater performance, stack Creatine Gummies with Prime Drive® for clean energy, Nitro 7® for enhanced muscle pumps, or Alpha Gain® for advanced muscle-building support. *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

description.html: Designed for women 35+ who want support for their wellness journey. As women age, their nutritional and lifestyle needs can change. The Complete Woman™ Wellness Program combines two daily supplements designed to complement a balanced diet, regular physical activity, and healthy lifestyle habits. Morning SupportStart your day with ingredients selected to help support daily energy, focus, and an active lifestyle. Afternoon SupportProvides complementary nutritional support to help you stay on track throughout the day and maintain your wellness routine. { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-9b34ef29-476f-4b96-9278-3d5ba4dee08e" } } This program pairs two powerful formulas: CTS VIVE™ (morning support) Prime Woman™ (afternoon balance) Together, they work with your body—not against it. Why It’s Different Most weight loss products ignore the real reason women struggle after 35: hormonal shifts, slower metabolism, and lower energy. Why Women Choose Complete Woman™ Designed specifically for women 35+ Supports an active and healthy lifestyle Helps promote daily energy and overall well-being Convenient two-step daily routine Pairs easily with balanced nutrition and regular exercise Who It's For Complete Woman™ may be a great fit for women who: Want a wellness program tailored to their stage of life Are looking for support in maintaining healthy lifestyle habits Want to feel energized and motivated throughout the day Prefer a simple daily supplement routine Important Information Results vary from person to person. Complete Woman™ is intended to support a healthy lifestyle and is not a substitute for proper nutrition, exercise, or medical care. These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. { "__shgImageElements": { "uuid": "s-3cde28f6-4877-4a19-9ec1-c6bfdde5c83e" } } FAQ S What is the Complete Woman™ Weight Loss Program?Complete Woman™ is a 2-step daily supplement system designed specifically for women 35+. It combines CTS VIVE™ (morning) and Prime Woman™ (afternoon) to support metabolism, energy, and hormonal balance throughout the day. How do I take it?Morning: Take 1 CTS VIVE™ capsuleAfternoon: Take 1 Prime Woman™ capsuleFor best results, take consistently every day. What’s the difference between CTS VIVE™ and Prime Woman™?This is what makes the system so effective:CTS VIVE™ (Morning Formula): Supports metabolic activation, helps kickstart fat burning, and contains more stimulating ingredients for energy.Prime Woman™ (Afternoon Formula): Focuses on hormonal balance, provides sustained energy, and uses a lower stimulant profile for a smoother feel.Think of it as: VIVE = Activate | Prime Woman = Balance + Sustain Does this product contain stimulants?Yes, but strategically.CTS VIVE™ contains mild to moderate stimulants for morning energy and metabolism support.Prime Woman™ uses a lower stimulant level, making it ideal for afternoon use without disrupting sleep. Who is this product for?Women 35+ who are experiencing slower metabolism, stubborn weight gain, or energy dips and want support for both metabolism and hormone balance. How long does it take to see results?Many women notice increased energy within a few days, improved appetite control within 1–2 weeks, and visible weight management results within 3–4 weeks. Can I take both capsules at the same time?It’s not recommended. This system works best when taken morning and afternoon to align with your body’s natural rhythm. Will this make me jittery?Most users do not experience jitteriness when taken as directed. CTS VIVE™ provides clean energy, while Prime Woman™ helps smooth and sustain energy levels. Do I need to diet or exercise?No extreme dieting is required, but best results come from pairing with a balanced diet, hydration, and light to moderate activity. Is this safe to take daily?Yes, when used as directed. If you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication, or have a medical condition, consult your healthcare provider first. What makes this different from other weight loss supplements?Complete Woman™ supports both hormones and metabolism using a 2-phase system designed specifically for women 35+, rather than relying only on stimulants.

description.html: Non-Stim Stack – Metabolism & Appetite Control Weight management support without the stimulants. The Complete Nutrition Non-Stim Stack is designed for anyone looking to support appetite control, metabolism, and body-composition goals without relying on caffeine or heavy stimulants. Whether you're sensitive to stimulants, already use a pre-workout or energy product, or simply want a weight-management routine you can use without adding more caffeine to your day, this stack gives you a simple non-stimulant approach. WHY CHOOSE THE NON-STIM STACK? Stimulant-Free – No need to add more caffeine to your daily routine. Appetite Support – Designed to help support healthy appetite control and make staying on track easier. Metabolic Support – Provides targeted nutritional support for a healthy metabolism. Body Composition Support – Complements a calorie-conscious diet and active lifestyle. Flexible Timing – A great option for afternoon or evening use when you want to avoid stimulants. Stacks Easily – Can complement many pre-workout, energy, or fitness products without significantly increasing your stimulant intake. WHO IS IT FOR? The Non-Stim Stack is an excellent choice if you: Are sensitive to caffeine or stimulants Already consume coffee, energy drinks, or pre-workout Want additional weight-management support without more stimulants Train later in the day Want help managing appetite while dieting Prefer a more flexible approach to your weight-management routine A SMARTER WAY TO SUPPORT YOUR GOALS Successful weight management isn't about simply adding more stimulants. Nutrition, activity, consistency, appetite management, and a sustainable routine all matter. The Complete Nutrition Non-Stim Stack was created to fit into that bigger picture—giving you targeted support without making caffeine the centerpiece of your plan. No heavy stimulants. No unnecessary complexity. Just focused support for your weight-management goals. For best results, use consistently alongside a balanced diet and regular exercise.

title: 3 TEST OXO Lean Mass Gainer by Legal Limit Labs

description.html: Legal Limit Labs 3-TEST-OXO Lean Mass & Performance Support Formula Building lean muscle takes more than hard training alone. Legal Limit Labs 3-TEST-OXO is designed to support strength, recovery, and overall performance by helping your body optimize key hormonal pathways involved in muscle development and training output.* This advanced formula is ideal for athletes and active individuals looking to maximize results from their workouts while staying within legal, supplement-compliant standards. Key Benefits Supports lean muscle development and strength gains* Helps promote *training performance and recovery Designed to assist the body’s *natural anabolic processes Ideal for lifters, athletes, and active adults seeking consistent progress* Formulated for use during intense training phases* { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-13028520-5ced-4637-aeb4-32e5c286d1b7" } } How It Works 3-TEST-OXO features targeted ingredients selected to support performance and muscle-building pathways tied to training intensity and recovery. By helping the body maintain a favorable environment for muscle growth, this formula supports strength output and overall gym performance when combined with proper nutrition and training.* Who It’s For Individuals focused on lean mass gains Athletes training at high intensity Adults looking to support workout performance and recovery* Those seeking a legal, supplement-compliant performance formula { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-1a141464-216a-4e34-9177-a42e49b9f96c" } } Ingredient Science Breakdown German Tribulus terrestris (40% saponins) Tribulus terrestris is a well-studied botanical traditionally used to support male vitality and performance. Research suggests its saponin content may help support libido and training performance, particularly when combined with resistance exercise.* German Tribulus terrestris (60% saponins) A higher-saponin extract of Tribulus terrestris is included to further support performance and vitality pathways. Saponins are the primary bioactive compounds studied for their role in exercise output and overall male wellness.* Eurycoma longifolia (Tongkat Ali) Tongkat Ali has been researched for its potential role in supporting hormonal balance and stress response. Studies suggest it may help support training intensity and recovery by assisting the body’s natural adaptation to physical stress.* Maca Root (Lepidium meyenii) Maca is an adaptogenic root traditionally used to support energy, stamina, and endurance. Research indicates it may help support physical performance and vitality without acting as a stimulant.* Fenugreek Extract Fenugreek contains bioactive compounds that have been studied for their role in supporting strength, body composition, and training performance. It is commonly included in performance formulas to support exercise outcomes when paired with resistance training.* DIM (Diindolylmethane) DIM is a compound derived from cruciferous vegetables and is studied for its role in supporting healthy hormone metabolism. It is included to help maintain balance within hormonal pathways associated with training and recovery.* Ginseng Extract Ginseng has a long history of use in performance and vitality formulas. Scientific research suggests it may help support energy levels, endurance, and resistance to physical fatigue during periods of intense training.* Bulbine natalensis Bulbine natalensis is a traditional botanical that elevates testosterone and performance focused on male vitality. It is studied for its role in supporting hormones and strength and training adaptation.* Boron (as Boron Citrate) Boron is a trace mineral that plays a role in nutrient utilization and metabolic processes. Research suggests boron may support the body’s ability to maintain healthy hormonal balance and bone strength, both important for resistance training.* Saw Palmetto Extract Saw palmetto is commonly used to support healthy hormone metabolism. It is included to help support balance within androgen-related pathways.* Zinc (as Zinc Gluconate) Zinc is an essential mineral involved in hundreds of enzymatic reactions in the body. It plays a critical role in immune health, recovery, and hormone production, making it foundational for physically active individuals.* Vitamin D3 Vitamin D3 supports bone health, immune function, and muscle performance. Adequate vitamin D levels are associated with improved strength and physical function, especially in active populations.* Magnesium (as Magnesium Oxide) Magnesium supports muscle contraction, recovery, and energy metabolism. It is commonly included in performance formulas to help support neuromuscular function during training.* Suggested Use Take 3 capsules daily. For best results, use consistently alongside a structured training program, adequate protein intake, and proper recovery. Stack Suggestions Pairs well with: Protein powders for muscle recovery Creatine for strength and power output Amino acids or recovery formulas post-workout Quality & Compliance Manufactured to meet quality and safety standards. This product is intended for use as a dietary supplement and should be used as part of a balanced nutrition and fitness program. *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. What is Legal Limit Labs 3-TEST-OXO? 3-TEST-OXO is a lean mass and performance support supplement designed to help support strength, recovery, workout performance, and the body's natural hormone balance when combined with proper nutrition and resistance training.* It features a blend of Tribulus extracts, Tongkat Ali, DIM, Maca, Fenugreek, Ginseng, Boron, Zinc, Vitamin D3, Magnesium, and other performance-support ingredients. Who is 3-TEST-OXO designed for? This product is intended for healthy adults who want to: Support lean muscle development* Improve workout performance and strength* Enhance recovery from intense training* Support natural hormone balance and male vitality* How does 3-TEST-OXO work? 3-TEST-OXO combines botanical extracts, minerals, and nutrients that support training performance, recovery, and healthy hormone metabolism. Ingredients like Tribulus, Tongkat Ali, Fenugreek, DIM, and Boron were selected to help create an environment that supports muscle-building efforts when paired with consistent training and proper nutrition.* What are the key ingredients? Key ingredients include: Triple Threat Test Complex (three Tribulus terrestris extracts) Tongkat Ali DIM (Diindolylmethane) Fenugreek Maca Root Rhodiola Rosea Eleuthero (Siberian Ginseng) Saw Palmetto Bulbine Natalensis Boron Zinc Vitamin D3 Magnesium How do I take 3-TEST-OXO? Take 3 capsules daily with 6–8 ounces of water. For best absorption, take: 1 capsule in the morning 1 capsule in the afternoon 1 capsule in the evening For best results, use consistently alongside a structured training program and balanced nutrition. How long does it take to notice results? Results vary based on diet, training intensity, recovery, and consistency. Many users begin noticing improvements in workout performance, recovery, or overall vitality after several weeks of consistent use, while muscle-building results depend heavily on resistance training and adequate protein intake.* Can women take 3-TEST-OXO? This product is formulated primarily for male performance and hormone support. Women who are pregnant, nursing, or considering hormone-support supplements should consult a healthcare professional before use. Can I stack 3-TEST-OXO with other supplements? Yes. It pairs well with products such as: Whey protein Creatine Pre-workout formulas EAAs/BCAAs Post-workout recovery products If stacking with other hormone-support supplements, review ingredient labels to avoid unnecessary overlap. Does 3-TEST-OXO contain stimulants? No. The formula is designed to support performance and vitality without relying on traditional stimulants like caffeine. Is this a testosterone replacement product? No. 3-TEST-OXO is a dietary supplement intended to support the body's natural hormone balance and training performance. It is not testosterone replacement therapy and does not contain prescription hormones. Is 3-TEST-OXO safe? When used as directed by healthy adults, the product is intended to be used as a dietary supplement. Do not exceed the recommended serving size, and consult your healthcare provider before use if you have a medical condition or take prescription medications. Who should not use this product? Do not use if you are: Under 18 years of age Pregnant or nursing Taking medication or under medical supervision without consulting your physician first Discontinue use if any adverse reactions occur. Is this product allergen-friendly? Yes. According to the product label, 3-TEST-OXO is allergen free. How many servings are in each bottle? Each bottle contains 90 capsules, providing 30 servings (3 capsules per serving). Does 3-TEST-OXO require cycling? The product directions do not require a specific cycling protocol. Users should follow the recommended serving instructions and consult a healthcare professional if they have questions about long-term use. *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-1a755845-128e-4e13-8908-fa971b97f400" } }

Crafted with a powerful blend of performance-oriented botanical extracts, amino acids, and herbal complexes, Primal is ideal for anyone who wants to maximize their training results without resorting to anabolic drugs or synthetic hormones.* Each serving works synergistically to support healthy testosterone production, nutrient delivery, muscle recovery, and metabolic function.* Supports Healthy Testosterone Pathways — A combination of clinically studied compounds helps maintain endocrine health.* Optimized for Strength & Size — Designed for athletes and weightlifters looking to support gains and break through training barriers.* Balanced Hormonal Support & Recovery — Herbal extracts help support the body’s stress response and recovery process.* { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-3dc608b4-0a6e-4886-bb14-38053d4c188a" } } 💪 Who PRIMAL Is For Men focused on strength training and performance Active individuals experiencing training plateaus Anyone looking to support natural testosterone levels Men seeking better recovery, drive, and consistency 🔬 Backed by Science — Transparent Ingredient Benefits Primal’s formula blends traditional botanicals and amino acids with evidence-inspired uses in hormonal and strength support. While no dietary supplement can replace medical treatment or guarantee results, research supports the potential roles of several key ingredients included in this product:* 📌 D-Aspartic Acid (DAA) An amino acid naturally involved in hormone synthesis and release, D-Aspartic Acid has been studied for its role in stimulating the production and release of hormones involved in testosterone synthesis. Some clinical evidence shows supplemental DAA can increase circulating testosterone in certain groups of men, especially those with lower baseline levels.* 📌 Fenugreek Seed Extract Fenugreek has one of the stronger research profiles among herbal extracts used in testosterone-support formulas. Multiple studies demonstrate that standardized fenugreek seed extracts can support healthy testosterone concentrations and related outcomes such as libido and strength in men.* 📌 Maca Root Traditionally used for stamina and fertility support, Maca root has a long history in natural health. Research into maca suggests benefits for hormonal balance and sexual health, with some evidence of modest support for testosterone-related outcomes when combined with lifestyle and training habits.* 📌 Saw Palmetto While often associated with prostate health rather than direct testosterone increases, saw palmetto contributes to overall male hormonal wellness and may help support androgen balance and metabolic processes important for performance and male vitality.* 📌 Deer Antler Velvet Deer antler velvet has been traditionally used for performance and recovery, though current human research on its direct effect on testosterone levels is limited and inconclusive. PRIMAL is ideal for active men, athletes, and individuals looking to support natural testosterone production, break through training plateaus, or maintain performance and recovery as they train harder or get older. PRIMAL is made with quality ingredients and manufactured following strict quality standards. We trust that you're not a big fan of protein lumps in your protein shake – they can ruin the taste of an otherwise-delicious drink. Protein coffee is the answer. Complete Roast Protein Coffee mixes exceptionally well; you get that smooth, unparalleled taste within seconds – even when you’re on the go .Love iced coffee? Simply blend our coffee protein powder with 8 oz. of iced water or milk with ice cubes to enjoy an iced coffee protein shake.We understand that for a busy, active individual like yourself, there’s a constant need for two things throughout your day: protein and caffeine. So why not get the best of coffee and protein powder in one convenient shake. In addition to packing 15-18 grams of protein each serving, it also delivers 75 milligrams of caffeine – that’s equivalent to an espresso shot – straight into your bloodstream. And because Complete Roast Protein Coffee is made with real Colombian coffee beans, the taste of our coffee protein powder surpasses that of any coffee-flavored protein powder. { "__shgImageElements": { "uuid": "s-80db0d4b-fb9d-42cf-8df8-88d2fcf87e02" } } Complete Roast Protein Coffee tastes amazing and has fantastic macros. It's super smooth(even with just a shaker) taste amazing and gives that extra kick of caffeine! I highly recommend this product. - Reu122 I bought Complete Roast Protein Coffee a few weeks back and I absolutely love it! description.html: Complete Roast™ contains the purest natural coffee beans, paving the way to a wonderfully delicious drinking experience. The natural aroma and flavor is derived from Colombian-sourced coffee beans, which are then craft-roasted. Combining the highest quality coffee beans and roasting techniques leads to the barista experience you can prepare in the comfort of your own home! In addition to our high quality coffee beans, we have added premium whey protein, which makes your coffee as nutritious as it is delicious.* You will receive: 3 - Complete Roast Flavors 1 - 20 oz blender bottle { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-4fcc69df-bf6e-4b56-8173-d144123f1f9d" } } Do More With Your Coffee Getting enough protein in a day isn’t easy, but we think it can be – with Complete Roast Protein Coffee! With 15-18 grams of high-quality protein packed into every serving, our protein coffee keeps you on track with your fitness goals – even when you’re on a coffee break. Made with real Colombian coffee beans craft-roasted, our protein coffee offers the best coffee flavors and a whopping 75-115 milligrams of caffeine per serving (equivalent to a double shot of espresso). Say goodbye to the artificial-tasting and chalky coffee-flavored protein powder in your gym locker. We want you to enjoy the real, aromatic taste of coffee in every sip. With our protein coffee, you're getting a delicious beverage without filler or 'bad' ingredients. No trans-fat. No added sugar. No gluten. We keep it simple so you can indulge in our protein coffee whenever you want. { "__shgImageElements": { "uuid": "s-957afa15-e07d-4268-aeeb-49284031fcbd" } } Quality whey protein Our unique blend of Whey Protein Isolates (WPI) and Whey Protein Concentrate (WPC) delivers 15 grams of fast-acting proteins and a complete amino acid profile to keep your hunger at bay and ensure your muscles get the building blocks they need for repair and growth. { "__shgImageElements": { "uuid": "s-439539a6-e933-4c27-81c4-2768a432dd0a" } } Real coffee beans Made with authentic, aromatic Colombian coffee beans, we’re confident that our protein coffee shake tastes exactly like the freshly brewed coffee you buy from your favorite barista –only with less sugar, fat, and calories,. And with 75-115 milligrams of caffeine per serving, we believe coffee doesn’t get better than that. { "__shgImageElements": { "uuid": "s-4458e8dd-5d02-416b-ba51-f37b00293632" } } No added sugars With just 1 gram of sugar per serving, our premium Complete Roast Protein Coffee is ideal for you if you’re following the ketogenic diet (or any diet, really), conscious of your daily sugar intake, or are just trying to do away with the pesky sugar-related mid-day energy crash. { "__shgImageElements": { "uuid": "s-00398747-7966-43a8-a98c-c37afcff904b" } } Low in Calories Drink to your heart’s content – without the guilt! At under 110 calories per serving, we’ve formulated our protein coffee shake to be free of junk ingredients and calories – you can be sure that every sip supports your diet goals, and gets you closer to your dream physique. { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-24852723-e7bb-4652-afc1-38631f50fcfd" } } Power Up Your Day… Complete Roast Protein Coffee Delivers Power up your day with our delicious, filling coffee protein shakes – anytime, anywhere. Coffee may taste amazing, but just take a look at its nutrition profile; the lack of protein and nutrients in coffee makes it a poor choice to support your fitness goals.Our determination to do something about it inspired us to come up with our specially-crafted coffee protein powder blend that meets your caffeine, protein, and micronutrient needs – all at the same time. { "__shgImageElements": { "uuid": "s-416332f0-385b-4e56-902b-b5c636231caa" } } Guilt-Free Treat There are times in life when you need that little helping hand to achieve your fitness goals. Like when you're in an afternoon slump and the smell of fresh donuts in your neighborhood bakery wafts over. Or when your evening meetings run over, and the only food nearby is that sinful cake leftover from your colleague’s birthday party.Let our coffee protein powder be your helping hand. With less than 110 calories per serving, you can indulge in this sweet treat at any time for an energy boost – minus the guilt! Need something to tide you over until dinner, beat the afternoon slump or help you lose weight? Spoil yourself with this guilt-free sweet treat! { "__shgImageElements": { "uuid": "s-8e944ca5-5677-4337-8b83-aac71e48d831" } } Crush Your Fitness Goals Your favorite coffee house drinks are incredibly unhealthy; they’re chock full of sugar, fats … and who knows what else. Don’t let your love of coffee sabotage your fitness goals.Choose Complete Roast Protein Coffee when you need a pick-me-up. It’s the ultimate nutrition hack to crushing your fitness goals.With 15-18 grams of added protein, you can be sure that you’re building a better physique in the process of enjoying our iced coffee protein shake – one sip at a time. And you’re not just achieving a better physique. We add nutrients to our protein coffee so you can work towards better health, too! { "__shgImageElements": { "uuid": "s-fd764a5e-5af0-484e-a467-ca8a02b67397" } } All-Day Convenient Energy Booster We understand that for a busy, active individual like yourself, there’s a constant need for two things throughout your day: protein and caffeine. So why not get the best of coffee and protein powder in one convenient shake?“But who has time to mix scoops of protein powder in coffee?” you may ask. “Besides, the separate addition of protein in coffee can get expensive.”That’s where our specially-formulated, coffee protein powder comes in handy. In addition to packing 15-18 grams of protein each serving, it also delivers 75-115 milligrams of caffeine – that’s equivalent to two espresso shots – straight into your bloodstream. And because Complete Roast Protein Coffee is made with real Colombian coffee beans, the taste of our coffee protein powder surpasses that of any coffee-flavored protein powder. Ready To Level Up Your Coffee Habit? If you lead a hectic, active lifestyle and wish you could harness the benefits of both coffee and protein powder in a single, convenient, and healthy shake, Complete Roast Protein Coffee is the ultimate nutrition hack for you. Start maximizing your daily coffee’s nutrition profile today – snag your favorite flavors before they sell out!

NX6® Nitric Oxide Performance Formula Bigger Pumps. Better Endurance. Stimulant-Free Performance. NX6® is an advanced nitric oxide support formula designed for athletes who want enhanced muscle pumps, improved training endurance, and greater workout performance—without caffeine, jitters, or crashes. Powered by clinically studied ingredients including Nitrosigine®, CarnoSyn® Beta-Alanine, and Capros®, NX6 helps support blood flow, vascularity, and workout intensity so you can get more from every training session. Whether you're chasing bigger pumps, higher training volume, or improved recovery between sets, NX6 delivers stimulant-free support that stacks perfectly with your favorite pre-workout or can be used on its own. Why You'll Love NX6® Supports powerful muscle pumps and vascularity Helps promote nitric oxide production and healthy blood flow Enhances workout endurance and training capacity Helps delay exercise-related fatigue Supports performance and recovery Stimulant-free formula with no caffeine Features clinically studied ingredients Ideal for strength athletes, bodybuilders, and fitness enthusiasts Can be stacked with any pre-workout formula Made for daily performance support Featured Ingredients Nitrosigine® Arginine Silicate Inositol A patented nitric oxide ingredient designed to support blood flow, vascularity, and workout performance. CarnoSyn® Beta-Alanine Clinically studied beta-alanine that helps support muscular endurance and fatigue resistance during high-intensity training. Capros® Indian Gooseberry Extract A powerful antioxidant-rich superfruit extract included to support circulation, nitric oxide activity, and recovery. If you're looking for a stimulant-free nitric oxide formula designed to elevate your training experience, NX6 delivers the support you need to perform at your best. FAQ's What is NX6®? NX6® is a stimulant-free nitric oxide support formula designed to help increase nitric oxide levels, support blood flow, enhance muscle pumps, improve vascularity, and delay workout fatigue. Who should use NX6®? NX6® is ideal for: Strength athletes Bodybuilders Powerlifters Cross-training athletes High-volume trainers Anyone looking for enhanced pumps without stimulants Does NX6® contain caffeine? No. NX6® is completely stimulant-free and contains no caffeine, making it a great option for those sensitive to stimulants or training later in the day. What are the benefits of nitric oxide support? Nitric oxide helps promote healthy blood flow and circulation, which may support: Improved muscle pumps Enhanced vascularity Better nutrient delivery Increased workout performance Greater training endurance What ingredients are in NX6®? NX6® features several clinically studied performance ingredients, including: Nitrosigine® Arginine Silicate Inositol CarnoSyn® Beta-Alanine Capros® Indian Gooseberry Extract L-Citrulline Malate Taurine What is Nitrosigine®? Nitrosigine® is a patented ingredient designed to support nitric oxide production, blood flow, vascularity, and exercise performance. Why does NX6® contain Beta-Alanine? CarnoSyn® Beta-Alanine helps support muscular endurance and may help delay fatigue during intense exercise. Can NX6® help with muscle pumps? Yes. NX6® was specifically formulated to support nitric oxide production and blood flow, helping promote fuller muscle pumps and improved vascularity during training. When should I take NX6®? For best results, take NX6® approximately 15–30 minutes before your workout. Consistent daily use may provide additional performance benefits. Can I stack NX6® with a pre-workout? Absolutely. Because NX6® contains no stimulants, it stacks well with most pre-workout supplements to help maximize pumps and performance. Can I use NX6® on non-training days? Yes. Many users take NX6® daily to maintain consistent nitric oxide support and ingredient saturation. Will NX6® make me jittery? No. Since NX6® contains no caffeine or stimulants, it provides performance support without jitters, nervousness, or energy crashes. Is NX6® good for evening workouts? Yes. Its stimulant-free formula makes it an excellent option for afternoon and evening training sessions. How many servings are in each bottle? Each bottle contains 120 tablets, providing a 20-day supply when taken as directed. How should I take NX6®? Take 3 tablets twice daily with water. Do not exceed the recommended serving size. Is NX6® only for bodybuilders? No. NX6® can benefit anyone looking to support circulation, workout performance, endurance, and muscle pumps regardless of training style. What makes NX6® different from other pump products? NX6® combines multiple clinically studied ingredients that support nitric oxide production, endurance, vascularity, and performance in a convenient stimulant-free tablet formula. Can men and women use NX6®? Yes. NX6® is designed for healthy adult men and women looking to enhance their training performance and workout experience. Is NX6® manufactured in the USA? Yes. NX6® is manufactured in a GMP-certified facility in the USA to ensure quality and consistency.

Elite Gold CX7 Creatine Why settle for one type of creatine when you can power your performance with seven? Elite Gold CX7 Creatine is engineered with seven different forms of creatine to maximize absorption, bioavailability, and muscle saturation — helping you train harder, recover faster, and build lean muscle more efficiently. Why 7 Types Matter Enhance absorption pathways Improve solubility and digestion Increase muscle creatine saturation Support sustained ATP energy production Reduce common bloating issues seen with single-source creatine This multi-source system ensures your body can absorb and utilize creatine more efficiently — delivering consistent strength and performance benefits. { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-e8d1882b-9bab-4504-b955-375da42cb604" } } What You’ll Feel More reps at heavier weight Increased power during explosive movements Improved muscle fullness Faster recovery between sets Greater long-term strength gains This is creatine — optimized. Who It’s For Lifters who want more than basic monohydrate Athletes focused on strength and power Anyone serious about maximizing muscle performance Individuals who experience bloating from traditional creatine 🏅 Why Choose CX7 Over Basic Creatine? Basic Creatine Elite Gold CX7 1 form 7 synergistic forms Standard absorption Multi-pathway absorption support Puffy Creatine face No Puff Loading Phase No Loading Phase needed If you're putting in elite effort — your supplementation should match. Train Harder. Recover Faster. Perform Elite. Elite Gold CX7 Creatine delivers next-level muscle energy support with a scientifically advanced 7-type creatine complex built for serious results. { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-9f2f4282-e4c0-4c81-9e74-a53cb10a06bd" } } How It Works Creatine helps your muscles regenerate ATP (adenosine triphosphate) — the primary energy currency used during short bursts of high-intensity activity like lifting, sprinting, or explosive movement. Increasing intramuscular creatine stores allows your body to: Deliver more power and strength during heavy sets Sustain higher training volumes Recover faster between sets and workouts Support lean muscle development Scientific research shows creatine supplementation consistently improves strength, power output, and muscle growth when combined with resistance training. How to Use CX7™ Creatine Complex Recommended Use:Take 3 capsules daily with 8–12 ounces of water. On training days, take your serving 30–60 minutes before your workout or immediately after exercise. On non-training days, take 3 capsules with a meal to help maintain optimal creatine levels. For Best Results Use every day, including rest days, for maximum muscle creatine saturation. Stay well hydrated by drinking plenty of water throughout the day. Pair with a consistent resistance training program and adequate protein intake to maximize strength and lean muscle gains. For even greater performance support, stack with NX6 Nitric Oxide Rush® before training for enhanced pumps, blood flow, and workout intensity. Pro Tip Consistency matters more than timing. Legal Limit Labs® RECOMP™ Body Composition Modifying Agent RECOMP™ is a premium, non-stimulant body composition supplement designed to support lean muscle growth, fat reduction, and enhanced recovery. Whether you’re in a bulking phase, cutting cycle, or simply aiming to improve overall physique, RECOMP™ helps your body optimize how it builds muscle and utilizes nutrients. Formulated with clinically studied ingredients, RECOMP™ works with your training and nutrition to help shift your body toward a stronger, leaner, more defined look — without hormones, stimulants, or harsh compounds. { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-a06136cf-9979-4e57-972c-92ff6aa58874" } } Key Benefits Supports lean muscle mass development Helps promote fat loss while preserving muscle Enhances muscle protein synthesis pathways Aids in workout recovery and adaptation Non-stimulant formula — no jitters, no crashes Suitable for both men and women Ideal for recomp, bulking, or cutting phases { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-3a63a658-6346-4091-94d0-f3c1d6c526e0" } } How RECOMP™ Works RECOMP™ delivers targeted compounds that support anabolic signaling and nutrient partitioning — helping your body prioritize muscle growth over fat storage. When combined with resistance training and proper nutrition, this formula supports improved strength, muscle density, and body composition over time. { "__shgImageV3Elements": { "uuid": "s-58de16e9-5aa8-4acd-85cc-9bc6fe208559" } } 🔬 The Science Behind RECOMP™ RECOMP™ is built around the concept of body recomposition — improving the ratio of lean muscle to body fat rather than focusing solely on scale weight. Research shows that meaningful changes in physique often occur through improved muscle signaling, recovery, and nutrient utilization, even when total body weight remains unchanged. RECOMP™ uses targeted, research-backed ingredients that support these physiological pathways. Phosphatidic Acid (PA) Phosphatidic Acid is a naturally occurring lipid that plays a role in activating mTOR signaling, a key pathway involved in muscle protein synthesis. description.html: 🔥 Na-Tren HGX™ – Advanced Testosterone & Mass Support Build Size. Strength. Performance. Na-Tren HGX™ is a comprehensive muscle-building formula designed to support testosterone levels, growth hormone activity, and anabolic performance—giving your body the tools it needs to grow stronger, recover faster, and perform at a higher level. Built with clinically relevant compounds and performance-driven botanicals, this formula targets multiple pathways of muscle growth, not just one. 💪 What Makes Na-Tren HGX Different Unlike basic test boosters, Na-Tren HGX combines three specialized complexes to support total anabolic optimization: 🔬 Testosterone Support Complex (920 mg) Formulated to help promote healthy testosterone levels and male performance. Includes: Massularia Acuminate Extract (4:1) – Traditionally used to support male vitality D-Aspartic Acid (DAA) – Known for its role in testosterone production Boron Citrate – Supports free testosterone levels Sodium (support compound) 🚀 Extreme Mass Complex (300 mg) Designed to support muscle growth, strength, and performance output. Includes: Ecdysterone – Plant-based compound associated with muscle protein synthesis Withania Somnifera – Supports strength, recovery, and stress response Phyllanthus Emblica (Amla) – Antioxidant support for recovery and performance ⚡ Growth Hormone Support Complex (100 mg) Targets recovery, sleep quality, and natural growth hormone activity. Includes: M P – Supports dopamine and hormonal balance Irish Sea Moss – Nutrient-dense support for overall health and recovery 🔥 Key Benefits 💥 Supports natural testosterone production 📈 Promotes muscle growth & strength gains ⚡ Enhances training performance and recovery 🧠 Supports hormonal balance and focus 🛌 Aids in recovery and nighttime regeneration 🏋️♂️ Who It’s For Na-Tren HGX is ideal for: Lifters looking to build size and strength Athletes wanting natural hormone support Anyone hitting a plateau in progress Customers building a complete mass stack 📊 How to Use Serving Size: 2 capsules Servings Per Container: 30 Take daily as directed (preferably with food or as advised by your coach or healthcare provider) 🔥 Stack It for Maximum Results For full 24-hour performance support, combine with: PRIMAL™ – Additional testosterone support SUPREME™ Pre-Workout – Energy, pumps, and performance DARK MIST™ – Sleep and recovery optimization 👉 Together, this creates the Ultimate Mass Stack 1. What is Na-Tren HGX designed to do?Na-Tren HGX is an advanced muscle-building formula designed to support healthy testosterone levels, growth hormone activity, muscle growth, strength, recovery, and athletic performance. It uses a multi-pathway approach to help maximize training results. 2. Who should use Na-Tren HGX?Na-Tren HGX is ideal for men who are serious about building lean muscle, increasing strength, improving recovery, and getting more from their resistance training program. 3. How long does it take to notice results?Many users begin noticing improvements in training performance, recovery, and overall vitality within the first few weeks. Muscle and strength gains typically become more noticeable with consistent use alongside proper nutrition and training. 4. Can I stack Na-Tren HGX with other supplements?Absolutely. Na-Tren HGX pairs well with creatine, pre-workout formulas, protein powders, EAAs/BCAAs, and recovery supplements. For maximum muscle-building support, it can also be combined with other products in the Complete Nutrition Ultimate Mass Stack. 5. Does Na-Tren HGX contain hormones or prohormones?No. Na-Tren HGX is formulated with dietary supplement ingredients that support your body's natural anabolic pathways and hormone production—it does not contain anabolic steroids or prohormones. 6. Can I use Na-Tren HGX year-round?Yes. When used as directed, Na-Tren HGX is intended to support long-term training goals and can be incorporated into a year-round supplementation program. 7. Do I need to follow a specific diet while taking Na-Tren HGX?For best results, combine Na-Tren HGX with a protein-rich diet, adequate calories for your goal, consistent resistance training, quality sleep, and proper hydration. 8. Is Na-Tren HGX only for bodybuilders?No. Whether you're a bodybuilder, powerlifter, athlete, or recreational lifter, Na-Tren HGX is designed to support anyone looking to improve strength, muscle growth, and recovery. 9. Can women take Na-Tren HGX?Na-Tren HGX was specifically formulated to support men's hormone health and muscle-building goals. Women should choose products formulated specifically for their nutritional and performance needs. 10. What makes Na-Tren HGX different from other muscle-building supplements?Rather than focusing on a single ingredient, Na-Tren HGX combines clinically relevant compounds and performance-focused botanicals to support multiple aspects of muscle growth, recovery, testosterone support, and athletic performance in one comprehensive formula. ⚠️ Important Notice Not intended for individuals under 18 Consult a physician before use Do not exceed recommended dosage ⭐ The Bottom Line Na-Tren HGX isn’t just a test booster—it’s a multi-pathway anabolic support system designed to help you: Train harder. Recover faster. Grow bigger. { "__shgImageV2Elements": { "uuid": "s-18f9e6ad-167a-4129-8ec5-a7b0f6fcd0c0" } }
